source_title: Wall Mount Reading Light Modern Up-and-Down Adjustable Lamp
description:
A refined hotel-style bedroom photographed at seated-to-standing eye level with a normal lens in a three-quarter view, framing the bed headboard wall and left nightstand together. The camera is at approximately four feet, level, positioned from the foot-left of the bed and angled toward the headboard wall, showing the full width of the headboard and the left bedside surface in the foreground.

The entire headboard wall is clad in tall vertical panels of dark espresso brown upholstered fabric or leather — deeply tonal, sumptuous, and seamless. The vertical seamed paneling runs from floor to ceiling, creating an enveloping cocoon of warm chocolate-brown material with a slight sheen. A polished brass oval electrical cover plate is mounted on the panel surface at bedside height, with a dual-socket plate.

The bed itself is a wide double or queen, dressed in layers of crisp white cotton duvet and multiple cream and warm linen pillow arrangements — firm king pillows behind, smaller European and lumbar pillows layered in front, in ivory and warm greige tones. The bedding is crisply made and luxurious.

In the foreground, a round side table with a black marble or black stone base and a round white marble or pale stone top holds a clear drinking glass of water, a pair of reading glasses, and a flat book or magazine stacked on the surface — a simple, elegant nightstand vignette. On the far right edge of the frame, a dark grey wool or velvet floor-to-ceiling curtain panels a recessed window, allowing only a sliver of cool grey-white daylight through at the window edge.

Focused warm amber pools of light rake from each side of the headboard onto the brown panel surface, adding dramatic directional reading light intensity to the wall surface.

A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
